title: Prep 0.4.0 release: bump version, roll up CHANGELOG
description: Prep 0.4.0 release: bump version, roll up CHANGELOG
acceptance_criteria: Rune::VERSION and plugin.toml [plugin].version both read 0.4.0; fledge run version-check passes; CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section is rolled into a new [v0.4.0] - 2026-08-15 section with a fresh empty Unreleased above it; fledge lanes run release (version-check, fmt-check, lint, test, spec-check, spec-lifecycle, smoke-test, build) passes end to end, including a successful gem build.
